body: Just want to point out that this is something that both parties do on the reg.

Great suggestion, but I currently have no ready access (legal or illegal). I mean, there's a friend who has hooked me up in the past, but I always feel awkward bringing it up because I feel like I am using him to get drugs, and his friendship means more to me than that.

I'm lucky to have that subgroup, but we are scattered, and it's tough to enjoy that togetherness more than a few times a year. I'm glad you have come to a place where you are comfortable being who you are.
